y = a(x - h)² + k

• (h, k) is the vertex.
• If a > 0, parabola opens UP (k is minimum).
• If a < 0, parabola opens DOWN (k is maximum).
• Axis of symmetry is the vertical line x = h.

For ax² + bx + c = 0:

• b² - 4ac > 0 → 2 distinct real solutions (two x-intercepts)
• b² - 4ac = 0 → 1 real solution (tangent to x-axis at vertex)
• b² - 4ac < 0 → 0 real solutions (no x-intercepts)

front: Sum and Product of Roots (Vieta's Formulas)
back:
For quadratic ax² + bx + c = 0 with roots r₁ and r₂:

• Sum of roots: r₁ + r₂ = -b / a
• Product of roots: r₁ · r₂ = c / a

Saves 45 seconds on 'What is the sum of the solutions?' questions!

(x - h)² + (y - k)² = r²

• Center is (h, k) — note the opposite signs!
• Radius is r (take square root of the constant on the right side).

[Independent Clause] ; [Independent Clause]

A semicolon separates two grammatically complete sentences without a coordinating conjunction (FANBOYS). Both sides MUST be able to stand alone.

[Must be an Independent Clause] : [Explanation, List, or Clarification]

The clause BEFORE the colon must be a complete sentence. What comes after can be a list, single word, phrase, or explanation.

An introductory modifying phrase MUST be immediately followed by the noun it describes.

❌ 'Running to the bus, my backpack fell.' (The backpack wasn't running!)
✓ 'Running to the bus, I dropped my backpack.'
